# langsmith_evaluators (Data Source)

Lists LangSmith evaluators, with optional filters. The nested `code_evaluator` / `llm_evaluator` payloads are surfaced as JSON-encoded strings. All pages are fetched.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_evaluators" "all" {}

data "langsmith_evaluators" "llm" {
  type = "llm"
}

output "evaluator_names" {
  value = [for e in data.langsmith_evaluators.all.evaluators : e.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_contains` (String) Filter to evaluators whose name contains this substring.
- `type` (String) Filter by evaluator type (e.g. `code`, `llm`).
- `workspace_id` (String) If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `evaluators` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--evaluators))

<a id="nestedatt--evaluators"></a>
### Nested Schema for `evaluators`

Read-Only:

- `code_evaluator_json` (String) JSON-encoded code evaluator payload.
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `llm_evaluator_json` (String) JSON-encoded LLM evaluator payload.
- `name` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `workspace_id` (String)
